_comments.run_non_v2h_twin: Boolean; this template defaults to false (baseline + advanced only, using extended all-baseline backed-load trajectories). Omission retains legacy true behavior.
_comments.usage: Copy this valid JSON template and pass --control-config. _comments is ignored. Every supported preference is present, including inactive fields. Defaults are device-specific; home overrides win, then per-EV overrides. No EV/HPWH weight sharing. Baseline performs no solves. Values in home_01 preserve the user's tuning.
_comments.hierarchy: defaults.ev/hpwh/hvac < homes.HOME.ev_defaults/hpwh/hvac < homes.HOME.evs.ID. Per-EV full settings can override any EV default.
_comments.controller: baseline or mpc. HVAC only supports baseline/pass-through. EV MPC supports perfect, external deterministic and historical scenario forecasts.
_comments.formulation: convex or milp. EV convex uses signed chemical power; MILP uses exclusive operating binaries. Convex output is discretely projected for actuation.
_comments.solver: CLARABEL (convex only), SCIPY (LP/MILP), GUROBI (convex/MILP; installed package and license required).
_comments.solver_options: Native backend options; quiet output and <=300 s enforced. Rainflow master solves share one 300 s OCP wall-clock budget; canonicalization cannot be forcibly interrupted.
_comments.horizon_hours: Finite positive planning hours >= control_minutes/60. HPWH scenario requires 12 hours.
_comments.forecast_hours: Finite hours >= horizon_hours; full external coverage required for deterministic forecasts.
_comments.control_minutes: Finite positive solve interval, aligned to plant step. HPWH currently 15 minutes. Mobility never triggers extra solves.
_comments.forecast.mode: perfect, deterministic or scenario. Scenario EV minimizes separate worst-path comfort and trip-shortfall costs, plus mean remaining costs; first command shared, later recourse.
_comments.forecast.file: External causal forecast JSON path, or null when not deterministic. Deterministic MPC requires an explicit file.
_comments.forecast.scenario_method: EV: knn_state (default), tod_only, tod_dow, tod_state, tod_dow_state, tod_dow_state_hier, tod_dow_hier, tod_state_hier. HPWH: daily_budget_high_rf_1 or daily_budget_high (unchanged).
_comments.forecast.scenario_count: EV positive integer; default 5. Greedy best-ranked non-overlapping completed paths; fewer valid paths allowed, equal weights. Zero paths triggers baseline fallback.
_comments.forecast.lookback_days: EV positive days; default 30. Historical origin pool. Replay selection reserves this entire pool plus kNN history before warmup.
_comments.forecast.knn_history_hours: EV positive hours; default 24. Prior home/away MAE window, whole scenario-grid intervals. Only used for knn_state.
_comments.forecast.scenario_minutes: EV positive integer minutes dividing a day; default 15. Must align with plant timestep and divide control interval. Does not change control clock.
_comments.forecast.prefix_control_intervals: EV nonnegative integer, default 4, fitting inside horizon. Apply only if scenario current home/away state differs from truth. Matching paths unchanged. When truly home, discard wholly covered trips and shift crossing departures to prefix end with full distance. When truly away, absorb covered departures into a zero-energy ongoing absence. Zero still anchors one plant interval on mismatch. No realized future mobility used.
_comments.model: HPWH rc, rc-old, rc-stratified or state-space.
_comments.model_path: Explicit existing predictor directory, or null for the selected bundled predictor. This is a model dependency, not legacy simulator configuration.
_comments.model_minutes: HPWH saved-model step, currently must equal 15.
_comments.enforce_cycle_limit: Independent boolean. EV: MILP OCP only, never projector. HPWH: MILP OCP plus projector; convex projector only.
_comments.enforce_dwell_constraints: Independent boolean. EV: MILP OCP only, never projector; physical interruption takes precedence. HPWH scope unchanged.
_comments.ev.persistence_weight: Nonnegative; 0 disables. Convex uses chemical-power variation. MILP uses L1 change of charge/discharge/idle indicators (2 per switch), each dt/N; load-following changes within a mode are not switches. Convex projection also penalizes chemical-power deviation from observed prior power.
_comments.ev.dwell_on_minutes: Nonnegative minimum active minutes, separately tracked for charging and discharging.
_comments.ev.dwell_off_minutes: Nonnegative minimum inactive minutes for each charging/discharging direction.
_comments.ev.max_charge_starts_24h: Nonnegative integer or null. MILP historical charge ends + planned charge starts cap; future=min(horizon,12h), history=24h-future. Active cycle continuation consumes no new start.
_comments.ev.max_discharge_starts_24h: Nonnegative integer or null; same end/start window for discharge direction. No convex or projector enforcement.
_comments.ev.projection: nearest or threshold. Availability, physical SOC and backed-load safeguards only; no cycle/dwell filtering. MILP retains chosen mode subject to safety.
_comments.ev.projection_tracking_weight: Finite positive squared-power tracking weight for convex projection.
_comments.ev.projection_switch_weight: Finite nonnegative convex projected-mode switching penalty.
_comments.ev.projection_threshold: Fraction [0,1] of rated charge/load-limited discharge, used by threshold projection.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.minimum_temperature_c: Soft upper-tank comfort target, degrees C.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.maximum_setpoint_c: High/on command setpoint, degrees C, >= low setpoint; native safety remains active.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.nominal_hp_capacity_kw: Positive delivered-heat kW or null to read measured native nominal capacity. RC model carries its own physical capacity.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.max_cycles: Nonnegative integer. Existing HPWH budget: horizon starts + min(1, preceding-hour stops) <= max_cycles. Projector enforces the first-step budget; this is NOT a rolling-24h cap.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.dwell_time_on: Nonnegative duration string, e.g. 60min, HPWH on dwell.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.dwell_time_off: Nonnegative duration string, e.g. 15min, HPWH off dwell.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.enforce_cycle_limit: Independent boolean. HPWH MILP OCP plus projector; HPWH convex projector only.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.enforce_dwell_constraint: Independent boolean. HPWH MILP OCP plus projector; HPWH convex projector only.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.minimum_lower_temperatur: Compatibility-only inactive field; keep null. Current formulation has upper comfort plus weighted-average legionella penalty.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.control_variation_weight: Compatibility-only inactive field; keep 0. Use persistence_weight for the active variation term.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.cop: Positive state-space heat-pump COP; RC predictors use their model COP.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.electricity_weight: Nonnegative HPWH electricity weight, default 1; independent of EV electricity_weight.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.legionella_cooldown_enab: Boolean; RC-only existing passive cooldown mask.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.legionella_cooldown_band: Finite positive cooldown hysteresis band, degrees C.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.persistence_weight: Nonnegative independent HPWH heat-variation weight; 0 disables. Can coexist with both cap and dwell.
_comments.hpwh.parameters.water_use_peak_l_per_min: Nonnegative flow threshold for existing draw indicator, L/min.
_comments.scenario_objective: HPWH electricity, legionella and persistence are arithmetic means across scenarios; comfort is max(per-scenario horizon-total comfort), not sum of stepwise maxima. Existing normalization preserved.
_comments.projection: HPWH caps/dwell use native binary HP Duty Cycle commands when enabled; native maximum-temperature safety can override. With both disabled, existing setpoint mapping is retained.
_comments.solve_clock: Solves at start and each control interval only. Projectors/safety checks run every plant step, including after timeout/failure.
_comments.timeout_fallback: EV baseline/fallback charges to comfort_soc_min. Rainflow requires certified exact-cost/master-bound gap, not only native MIP gap; failure/limit triggers fallback. HPWH unchanged.
_comments.EV formulation: convex: one signed battery-side power, piecewise efficiency-aware AC power; fixed home/away data. MILP: exclusive charge/discharge binaries. Negative prices with lossy bidirectional convex power require explicit MILP selection.
_comments.EV enforce_cycle_limit: MILP OCP only; historical cycle ends plus planned starts. Future window=min(horizon,12h), history=24h-future. No actuator cap enforcement. Separate charge/discharge caps use max_*_starts_24h keys.
_comments.EV enforce_dwell_constraints: MILP OCP only; independent of caps and weighted persistence. No convex or actuator dwell enforcement.
_comments.EV persistence_weight: Nonnegative EV-only variation penalty with dt/N: chemical power changes for convex, one-hot mode changes for MILP. Electricity, comfort, health and persistence use dt/N; cumulative degradation uses /N without a second dt.
_comments.EV trip_weight: Nonnegative penalty: trip_weight * sum(unmet_kWh)/(current_capacity_kWh * new_trip_count), zero with no new trips. Count departures after the measured initial state and before horizon end, including zero-distance trips. Scenario MPC minimizes the maximum path trip cost, separately from maximum comfort. Demand is debited at departure; comfort uses pre-debit SOC. Bounded slack preserves hard SOC limits; actual plant unmet energy is separately reported.
_comments.EV enforce_terminal_soc: Boolean: enable v/N * (e0-eN), where e=C_k*SOC uses measured faded capacity fixed within the horizon. v is the minimum known tariff over the solve calendar day, assigned directly in USD per battery-side kWh (no efficiency conversion). No additional multiplier. Credits energy surplus as well as pricing depletion. Does not require extended load/mobility forecasts. terminal_soc_weight is retired; legacy values are ignored with a warning when active.
_comments.EV enforce_discharge_budget / discharge_: Boolean and nonnegative battery-throughput SOC fraction (may exceed 1). Historical plus planned V2H discharge over the cycle window; excludes driving. Both OCPs support it; discrete projection is not a budget guarantee.
_comments.EV mip_relative_gap: Relative MILP incumbent gap acceptance threshold in [0,1], default 0.05. Missing/nonfinite gap on a nonconverged solve triggers baseline fallback.
_comments.ev.health_soc_min / health_soc_max: Soft health bounds: 0 <= min <= max <=1. Control preferences, not physical fields; hard OCP/plant bounds remain [0,1].
_comments.ev.health_soc_weight: Nonnegative common weight for lower AND upper health violations, with dt/N normalization.
_comments.ev.comfort_soc_min: SOC fraction [0,1]. Baseline/fallback charges immediately to this value; MPC penalizes shortfall throughout the horizon, including away time. Departure-comfort metrics separately use pre-debit SOC.
_comments.ev.comfort_weight: Nonnegative independent weight on dt/N-integrated SOC-floor shortfall. Soft reserve, active even with no forecast departures; may encourage extra pre-trip charge to retain the floor afterward.
_comments.ev.enable_degradation: Boolean, default false. Enables selected OCP aging cost; realized aging metrics always computed.
_comments.ev.degradation_method: none, rainflow, rainflow_multicut (same outer loop), or linear_throughput. none overrides enable_degradation; false disables every method. NMC SOC-aware reference metrics are always computed. All methods share reference cycle life and net depreciable cost and include driving. Smoothed/hh are deferred.
_comments.ev.rainflow_relative_tolerance: Default 0.001. Both MILP and convex require rainflow envelope error <= absolute_tolerance + this * incremental aging dollars. Also the convex whole-objective gap tolerance; MILP whole-objective gap separately uses mip_relative_gap.
_comments.ev.rainflow_absolute_tolerance: Nonnegative absolute allowance, default 1e-6. Applied to whole-objective gap and, separately in dollars, rainflow envelope error.
_comments.ev.rainflow_max_iterations: Positive integer supporting-cut solve limit, default 100. Uncertified result falls back to baseline.
_comments.reporting: Estimated and NMC SOC-aware reference degradation dollars for all cases. Net savings = baseline operating plus reference degradation costs minus case operating plus reference degradation costs. No twin-relative metrics or separate profit.
